say:0:1222702001:0.text: Isn't that the scholar from the Evergreen Conservatory up ahead?
say:0:1222702001:0.source_cn: 前面那位不是冬青学会的学者吗？

say:1:1222702002:0.text: Looks like he's searching for something... Let's lend him a hand!
say:1:1222702002:0.source_cn: 他好像在找什么东西……我们过去帮帮忙吧！

say:1:1222703001:1.text: Are you looking for something? Do you need any help?
say:1:1222703001:1.source_cn: 你在找什么呀？需要帮忙吗？

say:2:1222703002:1.text: Oh, wonderful! Who would've thought I'd run into such kind-hearted folks in the middle of nowhere?
say:2:1222703002:1.source_cn: 噢，太好了！没想到这么偏僻的地界还能遇到好心人！

say:3:1222703003:1.text: You see, I didn't notice there was a hole in my backpack, and a bunch of gold fell out! I'm trying to find them now.
say:3:1222703003:1.source_cn: 你们瞧瞧，我这包背了太久，一不注意竟然破了个洞，包里的...

say:4:1222703004:1.text: *Sigh* It took me months to save up for all that gold... Without it, there's no way I can catch any <style="highlight">golden peacocks</style>.
say:4:1222703004:1.source_cn: 唉，这些金币可是我攒了大半年的……要是找不回来，我今天...

choice_prompt:5:1222703004.text: *Sigh* It took me months to save up for all that gold... Without it, there's no way I can catch any <style="highlight">golden peacocks</style>.
choice_prompt:5:1222703004.source_cn: 唉，这些金币可是我攒了大半年的……要是找不回来，我今天铁定钓不上<style=highlight>黄金孔雀</style>。

say:6:1222703005:1.text: ... You've never heard of the golden peacocks? They're as famous as the damedangler species.
say:6:1222703005:1.source_cn: ……你们连黄金孔雀都不知道？那可是能和冥湾美人齐名的珍...

say:7:1222703007:1.text: No, in fact, they're even rarer than damedanglers. They're known as the king of fish!
say:7:1222703007:1.source_cn: 不！应该说，它是比冥湾美人更稀奇的、传说中的鱼王！

say:9:1222703008:1.text: Is that a bit of a stretch...?

say:10:1222703009:1.text: Hahaha... The truth will emerge only once we've caught one.
say:10:1222703009:1.source_cn: 哈哈，事实如何，总得先钓上来才能一探究竟。

say:11:1222703010:1.text: According to those veteran fishermen, Rustport is the only place with golden peacocks across the entire Esperia, and they are <style="highlight">most likely to appear at dusk and during the night</style>.
say:11:1222703010:1.source_cn: 那些老渔夫们说，整个伊索米亚大陆上只有锈锚港这片水域里...

say:12:1222703011:1.text: The most amazing thing is that it's rumored to eat only gold, making it look like pure gold itself! It's worth a king's ransom!
say:12:1222703011:1.source_cn: 最稀奇的是，据说它只吃金子，所以看起来也像是纯金打造的...

say:13:1222703012:1.text: That sounds really familiar... Haven't we come across this before?
say:13:1222703012:1.source_cn: 好熟悉的说法，我们是不是在哪里听说过……

say:14:1222703013:1.text: Ah! It's Rowan's duck, Bradduck, right? The legendary duck that eats gold and lays golden eggs!
say:14:1222703013:1.source_cn: 啊！是罗万的鸭子，布拉达克一世吧？传说中会吃金币产金蛋...

say:18:1222703015:1.text:
What?! You've seen a live Aix?!
I need to let my colleagues know later. They study birds.
say:18:1222703015:1.source_cn: ……什么，你们见过活的姝鸯？！\n回头我得转告我那个研...

choice_prompt:19:1222703015.text:
What?! You've seen a live Aix?!
I need to let my colleagues know later. They study birds.
choice_prompt:19:1222703015.source_cn: ……什么，你们见过活的姝鸯？！\n回头我得转告我那个研究鸟类的同事。

say:20:1222703016:1.text: ... This is for research! Research, I tell you!

say:21:1222703017:1.text: Forgive me if I sound boastful, but I'd say I'm the top fish expert at the Evergreen Conservatory.
say:21:1222703017:1.source_cn: 不是我自夸，在研究鱼类这方面，要是我自称第二，冬青学会...

say:22:1222703019:1.text: Oh, we can talk about this later. Please help me find the gold coins that fell!
say:22:1222703019:1.source_cn: 哎哟，没空聊这些了。快帮我找找掉出去的金币吧！

say:23:1222703020:1.text: Each extra coin increases the odds of catching a golden peacock!
say:23:1222703020:1.source_cn: 多一枚金币，就多一分钓上黄金孔雀的可能性！！

choice:19:0:1.text: Are you fishing to make money?
choice:19:0:1.male: Are you fishing to make money?
choice:19:0:1.female: Are you fishing to make money?

say:25:1222703018:1.text: Well... it's all for academic research.
say:25:1222703018:1.source_cn: 没办法，为了学术研究嘛。

choice:19:1:2.text: It'd be a loss if you didn't catch anything.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 没钓到岂不是得不偿失？
choice:19:1:2.male: It'd be a loss if you didn't catch anything.
choice:19:1:2.female: It'd be a loss if you didn't catch anything.

say:26:1222703006:1.text: Yes, using gold coins as bait is the only way to catch golden peacocks. They're a rare species of fish and as famous as the damedangler.
say:26:1222703006:1.source_cn: 是啊，用金币当诱饵才有可能钓上黄金孔雀。它可是能和冥湾...

say:0:1222704001:0.text: All the coins around have been collected. Let's return them to Jaxon!
say:0:1222704001:0.source_cn: 周围的金币都捡起来了，回去交给那位学者吧。

say:2:1222705001:1.text: Hey, Jaxon! We've recovered all the coins you dropped!
say:2:1222705001:1.source_cn: 学者先生，你掉的金币都找回来啦！

say:3:1222705002:1.text: Great... Fortunately, not a single coin is missing! It's lucky I ran into you.
say:3:1222705002:1.source_cn: 呼……还好，一枚金币也没少！万幸遇到了你们。

say:4:1222705003:1.text: Now, I just need to wait for <style="highlight">dusk to come</style>! Then, I'll use my gold as bait to catch the golden peacock!
say:4:1222705003:1.source_cn: 接下来只要等到<style=highlight>黄昏降...

say:5:1222705004:1.text: If you're curious, why not stay and see it for yourselves?
say:5:1222705004:1.source_cn: 要是你们也感兴趣，不妨留下来一起见证吧。

say:6:1222705005:1.text: Hooray! Chippy is eager to see the king of fish!
say:6:1222705005:1.source_cn: 好耶——！满满也想见见传说中的鱼王！

say:0:1222706001:0.text: It's finally dusk! Let's ask Jaxon when he's ready to fish! Chippy can't wait to admire the fish king!
say:0:1222706001:0.source_cn: 总算等到黄昏了，我们问问约克逊准备什么时候钓鱼吧！满满...

say:1:1222707001:1.text: Dusk is almost here! I've never felt time passing this slowly.
say:1:1222707001:1.source_cn: 黄昏总算降临了！我从来没觉得时间这么漫长过。

say:2:1222707002:1.text: Is it finally time to fish? Chippy can't wait!
say:2:1222707002:1.source_cn: 终于要开始钓鱼了吗？满满已经迫不及待了！

choice_prompt:3:1222707002.text: Is it finally time to fish? Chippy can't wait!
choice_prompt:3:1222707002.source_cn: 终于要开始钓鱼了吗？满满已经迫不及待了！

say:4:1222707003:1.text: Don't worry! I've got enough gold to forge a golden fish. There's no escape for the golden peacock this time!
say:4:1222707003:1.source_cn: 不用，放心！我这次准备的金币多得能直接打一条黄金鱼出来...

say:6:1222707004:1.text: But how are you going to use the coins as bait? Surely, they can't just go on the hook.
say:6:1222707004:1.source_cn: 可是，你要怎么把金币做成鱼饵呢？它肯定不能直接挂在鱼钩上。

say:7:1222707005:1.text: Hahaha... Just sit back and watch.

say:9:1222707006:1.text: Whoa! You threw all the gold coins into the river?!
say:9:1222707006:1.source_cn: ——哇啊！你……你怎么把所有金币都扔进河里了？！

say:10:1222707007:1.text: This is called the "groundbait" technique, which means throwing a big lump of bait into the water to attract the fish. It should work on the golden peacock as well.
say:10:1222707007:1.source_cn: 这叫“打窝”——把一大团鱼饵扔进水里，吸引鱼聚集过来。...

say:11:1222707008:1.text: Alright, it's time for me to work my magic! You all just patiently wait for a bite!
say:11:1222707008:1.source_cn: 好了，接下来就是我一展身手的时候了！你们就耐心等待鱼儿...

narration:13:1222707009:1.text: As the sky darkens, Jaxon's fishing rod remains still.

say:14:1222707010:1.text: How strange... Why hasn't the golden peacock appeared yet…?
say:14:1222707010:1.source_cn: 真奇怪……黄金孔雀怎么还没出现……

say:16:1222707011:1.text: It's the king of fish, after all, so it won't be easy to catch. Let's be patient a bit longer.
say:16:1222707011:1.source_cn: 既然是“传说中的鱼王”，肯定不会那么容易上钩的。再多一...

say:17:1222707012:1.text: Yes, I suppose you're right... If it were so easy to catch, I wouldn't be here.
say:17:1222707012:1.source_cn: 唉，说的也是……如果那么容易就钓到，我也不用亲自——

say:18:1222707013:1.text: It moved! We've got a bite!

choice:3:0:1.text: Want me to help you fish?
choice:3:0:1.male: Want me to help you fish?
choice:3:0:1.female: Want me to help you fish?

say:1:1222709001:1.text: Look at that golden, graceful body and that shade of vivid blue on its tail! It shakes off the hook with such elegance... Must be the legendary golden peacock!
say:1:1222709001:1.source_cn: 金黄的鱼影，婀娜的身姿，再加上尾巴那抹鲜亮的绿色，还能...

say:2:1222709002:1.text: It's even bigger and more magnificent than I imagined... No wonder the rich folks of Rustport are all obsessed with it!
say:2:1222709002:1.source_cn: 它比我想象的更巨大，也更华丽……难怪锈锚港的有钱人都对...

say:4:1222709003:1.text: You let it slip away right in front of you, aren't you upset?
say:4:1222709003:1.source_cn: 呃，你好像一点也不失望的样子呢……

say:5:1222709004:1.text: Not at all! The fact that the golden peacock shows up proves that I'm on the right track. It's just a matter of time before I catch it!
say:5:1222709004:1.source_cn: 为什么要失望？既然黄金孔雀出现了，那就说明我的方法没错...

say:6:1222709005:1.text: Guys, please let me know if you come across any signs of the golden peacock in the future! My research report depends on it!
say:6:1222709005:1.source_cn: 几位，如果你们以后发现了黄金孔雀的踪迹，也记得告诉我一...

say:8:1222709006:1.text: Don't worry. We'll make sure to remember!
say:8:1222709006:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我们一定会记得的！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1222708001:.text: Oh, wow! This fish is incredibly strong!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1222708002:.text: Magister, look at the fish beneath the water!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1222708002:.source_cn: 主人，快看水面下的鱼影！
cinematic_dialogue:1:1222708002:.male: Magister, look at the fish beneath the water!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1222708002:.female: Magister, look at the fish beneath the water!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1222708002:.text: Master, look at the fish shadows under the water!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1222708002:.source_cn: 主人，快看水面下的鱼影！
